chars: the grey-haired man in the olive jacket
the young woman in the vest
moments.action: A grey-haired man in an olive jacket crosses the dim workshop past the lift; the young American walks in through the shop floor; the young woman follows and ends up stopped in a doorway, framed by stripped car parts.

chars: the young woman in the vest
moments.action: Out of a near-black frame the woman and the American appear bent over an open engine bay, studying the inline-six. The shop goes dark again and a man hauls the roller shutter up, the car now backlit against the street.

chars: the older man in the plaid shirt
moments.action: The American and the older man in the plaid shirt stand apart across a gutted car, then talk face to face outside in tight close-ups. By the last shot they are back at the car's nose, hands open over the empty engine bay.

Men shove the striped Mustang through the shutter door, and the build takes over: a turbocharged engine swings down on a hoist, welders work beneath the lifted body in showers of sparks, until the bare shell stands finished on its wheels.

Outside by stacked tyres the American turns a helmet over in his hands while others bolt the turbo onto the motor; the cut jumps to the Mustang already out on the mountain road, hood off, sliding through a bend.

A look at the Nissan motor sitting in the Ford's bay cuts to the American harnessed behind the wheel, eyes fixed ahead. The car then breaks loose onto dirt, throwing a wall of dust as it drifts the hillside turn.

chars: the older man in the plaid shirt
moments.action: Back in the shop hands seat the Nissan twin-cam cover, work a wrench along the head and probe the valvetrain; the American and two helpers crowd one engine bay, and the man in plaid lifts a single injector up to the light.

The battered Mustang attacks the tarmac bends, then drops onto dirt. The crew watch from beside a green hatchback with toy figures on its roof as the car sweeps past in dust, and they set off walking toward it.
